narrative.overview:
Monet is a fresh, energetic approach to points and rewards optimization. The aesthetic is Soft & Tactile, relying on smooth continuous curves that feel soft but structured. The system builds trust immediately through expert confidence while keeping the UI frictionless and uncluttered. It explicitly rejects generic, machine-generated, or "AI slop" patterns in favor of bespoke, high-craft iOS-native elements.

**Key Characteristics:**
- Tactile and smooth (20pt continuous radii)
- Confident, vibrant green accents against clean backgrounds
- Deliberate, expert craft feeling
keyCharacteristics: Confident, vibrant green accents against clean backgrounds
rules: Never use gradient text (foregroundStyle with a gradient on Text). Use solid Theme.primaryGreen.
Never use Color.green, Color.orange, Color.red directly. Use Theme tokens.
Never use .cornerRadius(X) (non-continuous). Always use .clipShape(RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: X, style: .continuous)).
Motion standard spring: response 0.4, dampingFraction 0.7. Motion enter spring: response 0.6, dampingFraction 0.8.
Respect accessibilityReduceMotion — provide .none animation fallback for every entrance animation.
Never use the hero-metric template (big number + small label + supporting stats grid). It is banned.
dos: Do use continuous corner radii for all surfaces (style: .continuous).
Do use Theme.primaryGreen (not Color.green) everywhere the brand green appears.
Do use Theme.warningOrange for missed-earnings and nudge states.
Do maintain 20px uniform padding inside cards.
Do use the canonical spring presets defined in motion tokens.
donts: Don't use gradient text (foregroundStyle(gradient) on Text). Banned.
Don't use Color.green, Color.orange, Color.red directly — always use Theme tokens.
Don't use generic AI slop patterns, glassmorphism, or the hero-metric template.
Don't overwhelm the user with spreadsheet-like data; focus on the optimal recommendation.
